example_en: I especially like this picture.

example_en: We are all looking forward to our vacation.

example_en: I spend a lot of money on vacation.

example_en: There’s another way to the station.

example_en: I always meet him on Thursday at the university.

example_en: Everybody makes the world a little better.

example_en: It is important to love yourself.

example_en: When it’s dark, you can see nothing.

example_en: He has two children and loves them both.

definition: in addition, furthermore, to that, for that
example_de: Ich koche heute und brauche dazu Eier.
example_en: I’m cooking tonight and I need eggs for that.

example_en: For some problems we already have solutions, for others not yet.

example_de: Dafür musst du dich nicht entschuldigen.
example_en: You don’t have to apologize for that.

example_en: I can’t work in such conditions.

example_en: This is Klara and Lisa, with whom I live in an apartment.

example_en: This gift’s clearly for Marlene; it has her name on it.

example_de: Davon wissen wir nichts.
example_en: We don’t know anything about that.

example_en: I’ll pick you up in a moment.

example_en: Your cell’s ringing.

example_en: I want to buy you a special gift, what do you wish for?

example_en: We’ll have to talk about that tomorrow.

example_en: The woman whose father is ill is sad.

example_en: Back then I was making more money.

example_de: Daran denke ich jeden Tag.
example_en: I think about it every day.

example_en: My leg hurts a little in the morning.

example_de: Jemand wie du ist mein Freund.
example_en: Someone like you is my friend.

example_en: The man whose wife’s birthday it is has a present.

example_de: Oft leben mehrere Familien in einem Haus.
example_en: Often several families live in one house.

example_en: I’m sick, therefore I can’t come to the party.

example_en: I’m looking for my suitcase, in there are my things.

example_de: Niemand kennt die Antwort.
example_en: Nobody knows the answer.

example_de: Ich denke gerne zurück an jene Tage in Frankreich.
example_en: I like to think back to those days in France.

example_de: Manche Menschen mögen keinen Kaffee.
example_en: Some people don’t like coffee.

example_de: Ich mache Sport und danach trinke ich viel Wasser.
example_en: I exercise and after that I drink a lot of water.

definition: through it, as a result, as a consequence
example_de: Toni raucht nicht mehr und lebt dadurch gesünder.
example_en: Toni no longer smokes and is healthier as a result.

definition: against it, on the other hand
example_de: Mein Eltern sind dagegen, dass ich ein Auto bekomme.
example_en: My parents are against my getting a car.

example_de: Ihr solltest euch mehr Zeit für euch nehmen.
example_en: You should take more time for yourselves.

example_de: Sie vergisst viele Dinge, darum muss Tim sie oft an etwas erinnern.
example_en: She forgets a lot of things; therefore, Tim often has to remind her of something.

example_en: Klara wears the same dress that her mother wore for her wedding.

example_en: When are you coming home today?

example_de: Dennoch kannst du daraus etwas lernen.
example_en: Nevertheless, you can learn something from this.

example_en: Why didn’t you call me?

example_en: The glasses are on the table and the dog is underneath.

example_en: The one who solves the puzzle first gets an ice cream.

example_en: Do you have any advice for me?

example_en: Did you say something?

example_en: Mom, Dad, can I borrow your car?

example_en: Behind the house is a lake, in front of it a beautiful garden.

example_en: Where are we going tonight?

example_en: Why should I help him, he never helps me.

example_en: There at the trees the park ends and behind it is a big road.

example_en: Can you give me any information about this event?

example_en: Robin completes the tasks on the same day.

example_en: To what does your question refer?

example_en: What do you need a second car for?

example_en: With what are you doing that?

example_en: Nothing fits in between.

example_de: Was gibst du mir hierfür?
example_en: What are you giving me for it?

example_en: How do diseases emerge?

example_de: Die Maschine weist keinerlei Mängel auf.
example_en: The machine has no defects at all.

example_en: During their journey they get to know quite a few new places.

example_en: Any contact with the bacteria will make you sick.

example_en: What is your fight all about?

example_en: I don’t know what to talk about with Paula.

example_de: Ich hoffe, dass mir irgendjemand aus meiner Familie helfen kann.
example_en: I’m hoping someone in my family can help me.
